versions.changelog: Initial release: add a home dashboard widget that turns likes from playback sessions into short looping video moments. Feature a moment, browse or shuffle others, adjust the clip window, and open the full video from the selected point.

Find liked moments from any video liked during one of your playback sessions, even if the video was last played long ago. A new read-only candidate lookup narrows the search so the widget can find moments with fewer history requests while keeping video visibility checks in Cove's authorized search.
Give every liked moment an equal chance to be featured on each load, and scan candidate videos in an evenly random order instead of favoring the newest likes.

name: Blast From The Past
description: A home dashboard widget that replays the moments in your viewing sessions that ended in a like.
author: MidnightRider
